{"task":{"request":"Write one read-only SQLite query. Include every project ordered by id. Output project_id, active_task_count, successful_latest_count. Active tasks have archived=0. For each active task choose its latest attempt by greatest finished_at, then greatest attempt id for ties; count it as successful only if that chosen status is 'success'. A task without attempts is not successful. Include empty projects. Return {sql:string}.","schema":"CREATE TABLE projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, project_id INTEGER, archived INTEGER); CREATE TABLE attempts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, task_id INTEGER, finished_at INTEGER, status TEXT);"},"skill_catalog":{"ledger":"Deduplicate event ledgers and aggregate exact integer amounts.","schedule":"Find a common calendar interval across fixed UTC offsets.","dependencies":"Compute earliest starts and a critical path in an acyclic dependency graph.","selection":"Choose a finite bundle under budget, coverage and compatibility constraints.","memory":"Reduce scoped preference events into an auditable current snapshot.","sql":"Write read-only SQLite aggregates without multiplying joined rows.","file_edits":"Plan precise edits to local text files.","reminders":"Represent a reminder with an explicit time and delivery state.","conversation":"Produce a concise, sourced recap of a conversation.","incident_triage":"Record an operational incident and bounded diagnostic next steps."},"loaded_skills":{"sql":"Use only a SELECT statement or WITH followed by SELECT. Honor the requested output column order and deterministic row order. Pre-aggregate one-to-many child tables before joining them to another one-to-many relation, otherwise amounts and counts can multiply. Keep requested entities with zero qualifying rows using LEFT JOIN and COALESCE; filters on the optional side usually belong inside a subquery or ON condition. COUNT(*) after a left join can count a synthetic row; count a non-null child id instead. Choose latest attempts using the specified timestamp and tie-breaker before aggregating statuses. Preserve integer cents and do not assume hidden uniqueness constraints."},"handoff":{"assignment":"Draft a read-only SQLite SELECT/WITH query that lists every project by id, counts non-archived tasks, selects each active task’s latest attempt by finished_at then attempt id, and counts successful selected attempts while preserving empty projects."}}

output_text: {"answer":"WITH active_tasks AS (SELECT id, project_id FROM tasks WHERE archived = 0), ranked_attempts AS (SELECT task_id, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task_id ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM attempts), project_counts AS (SELECT at.project_id, COUNT(at.id) AS active_task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_latest_count FROM active_tasks AS at LEFT JOIN ranked_attempts AS ra ON ra.task_id = at.id AND ra.rn = 1 GROUP BY at.project_id) SELECT p.id AS project_id, COALESCE(pc.active_task_count, 0) AS active_task_count, COALESCE(pc.successful_latest_count, 0) AS successful_latest_count FROM projects AS p LEFT JOIN project_counts AS pc ON pc.project_id = p.id ORDER BY p.id;"}
